description: Product ranges, the digital and poster output, the client roster, and the studio's own brand rules.
story: The back half is the working evidence: packs and ranges, a wall of posters and social sets, the roster the studio had earned by 2021, and finally its own colour and typeface rules — the guidelines page being the one place a media house has to take its own advice.
